title: Pip and the Up-and-Down Seesaw
moral: Some fun only works when we share it with friends.
description: There's a brand-new playground in Clover Wood, and Pip wants it ALL for himself! But a seesaw won't go up without a friend. Learn opposites like up and down, fast and slow, hot and cold with Pip, Tumble, Hazel and Nana Hoot in this funny animated story about sharing, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Clover Wood has a brand-new playground!
A slide! A swing! And a big, bright seesaw!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! It is so exciting!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! I am first! It is all MINE!
Zoooom! Pip ran off. He did not wait for Tumble. He did not wait for Hazel. Uh-oh...

narration.text: Pip jumped on the seesaw. He went... nowhere!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Up, seesaw! Go UP!
He hopped. He bopped. BONK! The seesaw stayed down, down, down.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! A seesaw needs two friends, little Pip. One goes up, one goes down. Up and down are opposites.
Nana's glasses slipped down her beak. She pushed them up. Down... up! Down... up!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hoppo-sites! Got it! So the opposite of UP is... SIDEWAYS!
Silly Pip! What is the opposite of UP? Tell me!
DOWN! You're so smart!

narration.text: But Pip did not want to share yet. He ran to the slide instead.
He climbed the ladder. Slow... slow... slow. Step... by... step...
Then WHEEEE! He zipped down, fast, fast, fast!
Climbing was slow. Zooming down was... what? Say it!
FAST! Yes! Slow and fast are opposites!
FLUMP! BONK! Pip landed in the leaf pile, with a leaf on his nose.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Can I have a turn, please, Pip?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Not now! Mine!
Tumble's big ears drooped down, down, down.

narration.text: Pip ran to the swing. But nobody pushed him. Nobody giggled with him. It was very, very quiet.
Pip looked at his friends on the bench. All mine didn't feel so super-duper.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I'm sorry, friends. Tumble, will you take a turn with me?
So Tumble took a turn. Round and round and round he turned! Wibble-wobble!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee-hee! Not that kind of turn, Tumble!

narration.text: Back to the seesaw! Tumble climbed on one end.
Ka-BOING! Pip shot up, up, UP!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Whoa! Hello, birdie! Nice nest! Please may I come down?
BOING! went Hazel's prickles!
Poor Tumble was stuck down low. Pip was stuck up high.

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: I know! Tumble, scoot to the middle!

narration.text: Tumble scooted to the middle. Hazel hopped on with Pip.
And then... up, down! Up, down! UP, DOWN!

narration.speaker: tumble

Your turn! Pat your head for UP! Touch your toes for DOWN! Ready? Go!

narration.text: Then Nana brought a snack! Warm cocoa and icy lollies. Pip gave the very first lolly to Tumble.
Tumble dipped his trunk in the cocoa...

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ooh! Too HOT! HONK!
So he popped his trunk on the lolly. Brrrr! Too COLD! AH-CHOOOO!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Blow on your cocoa first, dear. Now, friends...
